cards.text: VEL-VIV-OLDMONEY-GRID-01 — THE OLD MONEY WORKDAY LOOK (BIRKIN GRID GREENSCREEN)

cards.title: CONCEPT
cards.text: Greenscreen AI UGC for the Vivienne mirroring Annalise Salm's oversized-travel-bags reel: 2x2 grid hook of real women carrying Birkins with a centred serif title, then hard-cut stills of OUR bag with the creator keyed bottom-centre for the whole runtime, ending on the live PDP. VO = ElevenLabs Woman Over 40, one take, 62.0s. STORYBOARD STAGE: approve the grid plate (A/B/C), the creator (C1/C2/C3) and the beat frames here before any HeyGen render fires.

cards.title: OUR VERSION — VEL-VIV-OLDMONEY-GRID-01 (62s, Woman Over 40 VO)  ·  brands/velantra/products/vivienne/concepts/9-2-26-old-money-birkin-grid-gs

cards.text: NOTES

cards.title: PRODUCT CALL
cards.text: Brooks said Vivienne; the sent script names the Meridian twice. Built for the Vivienne. Re-points to the Meridian in one pass if that was the intent (swap product frames, restore 'laptop' and 'doesn't slouch', re-voice one line).

cards.title: SCRIPT EDITS
cards.text: All product-truth driven: dashes out; 'full grained / hand-antiqued brass' -> 'vegetable tanned / aged brass' (the cleared claims); laptop dropped (no capacity claim until a unit is measured); 'doesn't collapse or slouch' dropped (the Vivienne IS soft and slouchy, that claim is banned for it). Full table in SCRIPT.md.

cards.title: VO
cards.text: Woman Over 40, eleven_v3 Creative, one take, 62.0s, 178 wpm, no atempo. No pause around the brand words (plain respellings, no hyphens).

cards.title: CREATOR
cards.text: Cast fresh on the HAALAND natural recipe (hand up, lips parted, off-centre, real light on flat green). C2 Helen is the default. C1 and C3 re-rolled once; all three now hold flat green with full headroom. Pick one here.

cards.title: GRID PLATES
cards.text: Real Pinterest street-style photographs of real women with Birkins, nothing generated, Birkin never in a prompt. Open ruling: unlicensed third-party photos as hook stills (same as HAALAND-01 / VIV-CELEB-GS-01).

cards.title: MIRROR NOTES
cards.text: The reference's IG-post chrome is not reproduced (Velantra IG is banned; no faked posts). Its list is the hook only; from 0:07 every frame is our bag. Close is the live PDP recording, the ad ends there.

cards.title: COMPOSITE (build stage)
cards.text: Size on the head: 0.20 W head width, head centre 0.50 W, 60px bottom bleed. C2 measures scale 0.513 / x=330 / y=1192 / head top 1256; captions centred at y<=1120. Chromakey on the sampled green, 0.08/0.03, despill 0.15.
